_note: Retailer policies change. Each entry records when it was last checked; the app always tells you to confirm on the policy page before asking. Edit this file to add retailers or update terms.

bestbuy.name: Best Buy
bestbuy.conditions: Identical item (same model number), new, in stock and sold by the competitor itself — not a marketplace seller. No membership-only, clearance or bundle prices. My Best Buy paid members get a longer window.

target.name: Target
target.conditions: Competitor price matching ended July 2025. Target still matches its own lower price (store or target.com) within 14 days of purchase.

walmart.name: Walmart
walmart.conditions: No competitor matching since 2019. Stores may match a lower walmart.com price on items sold by Walmart (not marketplace sellers) at checkout.

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.conditions: No price matching or general price protection. If the price drops while the item is still returnable, returning and re-buying is the only route.

costco.name: Costco
costco.conditions: No competitor matching. Refunds the difference if Costco's own price drops within 30 days; online purchases are adjusted online, warehouse purchases in person.
